projection.projection_goal: Provide the evaluation-expert-consumer skill with a template-agnostic evaluation pipeline contract: red-line check, dimension scoring, weighted aggregation, and report assembly. Dimension set and weights are runtime-injected rather than hard-coded.

source_slice.slice_topic: generic evaluation pipeline with red-line gating and evidence-driven scoring (template-agnostic)

concept_mappings.notes: Runtime-injected dimension catalog (names, weights, baselines, red-line thresholds). The pipeline must NOT default to a hard-coded set when this input is missing; it must block instead.
Structured test case with expected_behavior_sequence, expected_output, and mandatory tool calls.
Captured execution evidence for the evaluated employee turn(s).
First step: evaluate red-line conditions defined in metricSet; if any triggered, short-circuit to fail-out.
Iterate over dimensions in metricSet and score each from baseline using evidence-driven adjustments.
Apply weights from metricSet, enforce per-dimension floor and overall threshold defined in metricSet.
Final step: assemble the structured evaluation report with traceable evidence for each adjustment.
Final deliverable matching the evaluator SKILL output schema.

relation_mappings.notes: Red-line evaluation must complete before per-dimension scoring runs; pipeline short-circuits on red-line trigger.
All declared dimensions must produce a final score before weighted aggregation runs.
Report build must consume the final overall score and pass/fail decision.

constraint_mappings.notes: Block when metricSet is missing or empty; do not silently fall back to a hard-coded dimension set.
When any red-line condition declared in metricSet is satisfied, set passed = false and short-circuit before aggregation.
passed = true requires overall_score >= metricSet.overall_threshold AND every dimension >= metricSet.per_dimension_threshold AND no red line triggered.
Every dimension adjustment must reference a quotable evidence span from executionTrace; no evidence-free adjustments are allowed.
If any open question is unresolved (e.g., ambiguous expected behavior), defer report finalization and surface the block.

forbidden_assumptions: Do not hard-code a default dimension set when metricSet input is missing.
Do not bypass red-line short-circuit by averaging it into overall_score.
Do not accept dimension adjustments without evidence references.
required_clarifications: Clarify whether a specific employee template is being evaluated; if yes, prefer the template-specific topic instead of evaluation-workflow.
